purpose: Fair strong nearest-framework adaptation and real completed-check task benefit, not another weak interval-LP ablation
contract: Both use identical full-halfline continuous dual validation, target-completed finite physical witnesses, observation error bands, mesh/refinement limits, joint tolerances, same preflight phase gate and single-thread environment. Pointwise comparator uses endpoints then median among unresolved uncomputed candidates. Only loading-guided cross-time transport changes. No cross-algorithm numerical cache. Whole-cell and secant checking costs included. Each algorithm starts a fresh strict-feasibility solve. Warmup and disk serialization excluded identically. Three AB/BA/AB timing repeats in the same process; not fresh-process or independent-machine repetitions.
criteria: Report all opposite decisive labels, losses and failures
Replay all retained LPs and continuous residual cells
Check all positive decisions against generating truths and both input-envelope endpoint scalings
Compare full task elapsed time including setup and scheduling
At each preregistered budget count completed decisive requests and sufficient predictions; never count an unfinished LP or certificate
Freeze before this study's first execution; inherited truths and earlier results are already known, so this is exploratory not blind
limitations: Four previously used synthetic spectra, four same-profile observation sets and two correlated input-envelope settings; 584 correlated target requests are not 584 independent trials
Our adaptation of the nearest classical framework, not the authors original code or a global best-possible implementation
Same-profile temporal transport can also be added to other classical solvers; cannot establish that prior frameworks are incapable of these tasks
No claim of earlier first sufficient time, improved point prediction, continuum optimum or universal acceleration
Floating-point replay is not directed rounding
Timing is machine-specific and three repeats do not establish a population runtime guarantee
Real material validity is assessed separately; synthetic timing does not fill its information gap
